question: Can a bounded monthly reversal diagnostic expose arithmetic, direction, calendar and information-availability defects in our research chain?
use: pipeline diagnostic, not trading selection or literal paper replication

definition.adjustment: reuse BaoStock adjustflag=2 quotation proxy; provider historical arrival and total shareholder-return equivalence unqualified
definition.eligibility: fixed 600 codes from bound historical cohort sources; both calendar month ends present, positive finite close, tradestatus=1, current isST=0; no future data in eligibility
definition.label: close(first_session_month_t_plus_2)/close(first_session_month_t_plus_1)-1; exact calendar dates, positive prices, suspension prices retained marked; missing NOT filled
definition.quintiles: sort raw ascending; fractional membership across exact ties, five equal target-weight groups formed before outcome missingness; each group weight sum=1
definition.comparison: raw vs negative score is sign-invariance diagnostic, no new information; all eligible equal-weight reference; no claim incremental alpha

metrics: date-level Spearman with average ties, then equal-month mean
five group observed weighted contribution and unknown weight, paired low-minus-high
12-month circular block uncertainty for mean IC, 2000 draws seed 20261020
tests: monthly quintile tie membership and unknown weight preservation
existing RankIC timing rejection tests; no claim covers actual financial disclosures
evaluation.annualization: no annualized return claim if outcome missing or quotation/execution qualification incomplete; monthly contribution descriptive only

scope_limits: no original LEI or other owner four-factor study
size/BP/EP only qualification, no missing fields invented
not unseen history; old P1 price history already examined
success: correctness established only for checked invariants; empirical sign/range/monotonicity not hard pass threshold
stop: bounded diagnostic reconciled; fundamental branches blocked if required point-in-time fields absent
